subject: The countdown is on: Berlin Robotics & AI Hackathon
body:
Builders, the countdown is on. ⏳

The 2nd edition of the Berlin Robotics & AI Hackathon is just around the corner, and things are moving fast behind the scenes.

We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to bring together some of the most exciting names in robotics and AI, and we can’t wait to share who’s on board. 🤖

📅 November 21-22, Berlin
💰 10.000€ in prizes: cash, credits, robots and more

A quick reminder: spots are extremely limited. To make sure we build the best possible teams, you will need to complete an application form to be accepted.

Keep an eye on our page, because the form is dropping soon and early applicants will have the best chances.

One of the biggest Physical AI hackathons in Europe is getting closer.

Stay tuned.

👉 Register now: [https://luma.com/h0mcaqio](https://luma.com/h0mcaqio)
